import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Code254History

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Code254HistoryAudit
open Code254 Code254Proof Code254History
set_option maxRecDepth 10000

example : accepts 0 0 = false := by decide
example : accepts 1 0 = true := by decide
example : accepts 1 1 = false := by decide
example : accepts 13 0 = false := by decide
example : accepts 12 0 = false := by decide
example : accepts 51 6 = true := by decide
example : accepts 170 0 = true := by decide
example : accepts (node 1 (P 1 (P 1 1))) 1 = false := by decide

 theorem quote_caller (p : RawProof) :
    accepts p.quote p.conclusion = p.valid := by
  cases h : p.valid with
  | false =>
      apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
      intro ha
      have hb := (accepts_iff_check p.quote p.conclusion).mp ha
      rw [p.check_quote, h] at hb
      contradiction
  | true =>
      exact (accepts_iff_check p.quote p.conclusion).mpr (by rw [p.check_quote, h])

 theorem arbitrary_input_caller (code conclusion : Nat) :
    accepts code conclusion = true ↔ check code conclusion = true :=
  accepts_iff_check code conclusion

 theorem refutation_caller :
    C254 F ↔ ∃ code, accepts code F = true := c254_iff_history F
